modules.title: Module 1: Pointer Fundamentals

topics.title: Introduction to Pointers
topics.shortDescription: Master the concepts of Introduction to Pointers in C.
learningObjectives: Apply Introduction to Pointers in real scenarios
topics.conceptExplanation: This topic covers Introduction to Pointers. Pointers are variables that store memory addresses.

simpleExample.explanation: We declare a variable and a pointer that points to its address.

stepByStep: Declare the pointer and assign the address.

commonMistakes.explanation: Accessing an uninitialized pointer leads to undefined behavior.
commonMistakes.correction: Always initialize pointers, even to NULL.

realWorldExample.explanation: Pointers are essential for dynamic memory.

practice.prompt: Write a small program to demonstrate Introduction to Pointers.

quiz.question: What is a pointer?
options: A variable that stores a memory address
A standard data type like int
A built-in C function
None of the above
